common_definitions.time_weighted_percentile: Treat each cgroup/spool sample as piecewise-constant until the next sample, clip each interval to the named phase, pool interval durations across n=3, then take the weighted percentile.
common_definitions.cross_run_lifecycle_quantile: Align each run at its measured ingest phase start, linearly interpolate each raw series onto a 0.5-second real-time grid, then calculate q0/q25/q50/q75/q100 across n=3 at each grid point.
common_definitions.dense_sample_time: Cgroup/spool samples retain raw kind-node unixNano and are differenced against host phase timestamps, matching the formal validator and published percentile contract. Clock probes measured the node about 20ms ahead; this uncertainty is below the 250ms sample cadence and is not silently removed.
common_definitions.lifetime_peak: Exact final in-process cgroup-v2 memory.peak; median/min/max are across n=3. This is not max(memory.current median trajectory).
common_definitions.upload_time: Collector log upload-completion unixNano converted from node to host clock using linear interpolation of measured node-minus-host skewNano between bracketing probes; reported relative to measured phase boundaries.
common_definitions.upload_bytes: Raw rotated JSONL file size (rotationTask.size), not gzip object bytes.

a_rate_summary.csv.row: one target event rate; n=3 independent A arms
a_rate_summary.csv.aggregation: time-weighted ingest percentiles plus cross-run min/median/max exact final values

a_lifecycle_quantiles.csv.row: one target rate and one 0.5-second grid point
a_lifecycle_quantiles.csv.aggregation: Align each run at its measured ingest phase start, linearly interpolate each raw series onto a 0.5-second real-time grid, then calculate q0/q25/q50/q75/q100 across n=3 at each grid point.

a_uploads.csv.row: one upload ordinal at one A target rate, summarized across n=3
a_uploads.csv.aggregation: min/median/max across corresponding ordinal in n=3
a_uploads.csv.units: time=seconds relative to ingest; size=raw JSONL MiB

b_phase_composition.csv.row: one B target rate, phase window, source, and memory/spool metric
b_phase_composition.csv.aggregation: Treat each cgroup/spool sample as piecewise-constant until the next sample, clip each interval to the named phase, pool interval durations across n=3, then take the weighted percentile.

b_lifecycle_quantiles.csv.row: one B target rate and one 0.5-second grid point
b_lifecycle_quantiles.csv.aggregation: Align each run at its measured ingest phase start, linearly interpolate each raw series onto a 0.5-second real-time grid, then calculate q0/q25/q50/q75/q100 across n=3 at each grid point.

b_upload_reclaim_runs.csv.aggregation: exact per-run event times and linearly interpolated cgroup composition 1 second before/after first observed zero-spool reclaim

b_upload_reclaim_summary.csv.row: one B target rate and one lifecycle metric
b_upload_reclaim_summary.csv.aggregation: min/median/max across n=3 independent B arms; null runs excluded

b_idle_window_validator_medians.csv.row: one B target rate, one final-idle 30-second window, and one cgroup metric
b_idle_window_validator_medians.csv.aggregation: unweighted raw-sample median per arm exactly matching validator median_window(), plus median of the three arm medians

c_candidate_arms.csv.aggregation: exact final cgroup counters and candidate-evaluator adjacent sampled composition

c_candidate_summary.csv.aggregation: cross-run min/median/max, sums for counters, and exact validator verdict

integrity_totals.csv.row: one campaign total or recomputed invariant
integrity_totals.csv.aggregation: sum/distinct/equality across all 27 arms, stated per row

column_definitions.csv.aggregation: exact data dictionary; no measurement aggregation

results.json.row: nested campaign summary plus discrepancy list; dense lifecycle grids remain in CSV

field_conventions.p50/p95/p99: time-weighted percentile when used in A rate or B phase summaries
field_conventions.q0/q25/q50/q75/q100: cross-run lifecycle quantile at a fixed aligned time
field_conventions.events_max: final absolute memory.events max counter; baseline was zero in these fresh cgroups, so it is also the campaign-arm delta
field_conventions.psi_full_total_usec: final absolute cgroup memory.pressure full total counter; baseline was zero in these fresh cgroups, so it is also the campaign-arm delta
field_conventions.peak_to_limit_ratio: exact final memory.peak bytes divided by configured memory.max bytes
field_conventions.reclaim_zero: first valid event-spool sample at or after runtime upload completion where raw+gzip+tmp event-file bytes equal zero
